subject: english
title: Vocabulary 2
subtitle: Be Prepared — 6 words for getting ready for extreme weather, SB p. 14, TR 1.5–1.6. Word Rack, a game and a card per word, Sound Lab (/t/ and /d/), listen and stick, Emergency Plan.

content: Learn six words about getting ready for extreme weather.
Listen to a weather report and summarize the plan.
Make an Emergency Plan for his own home.
language: Use the six words: a plan, supplies, a flashlight, an emergency, evacuate, a shelter.
Hear the difference between the sounds /t/ and /d/.
Use academic language: summarize. Use content vocabulary: a forecaster, whole.
